missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Туман' is a masculine noun staying in the nominative as the subject of 'был'. 'Густой' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'утром' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Туман' is the accusative direct object of 'разогнал', identical to the nominative for this inanimate masculine noun. 'Ветер' is the subject.
Strategic focus: Genitive with compound preposition. 'Тумана' takes the genitive after 'из-за' to give the cause. 'Дорога' is the nominative subject of 'исчезла'.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'Тумане' is the prepositional after 'в' to show where they drive. 'Машины' is the nominative plural subject, and 'медленно' adds manner.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Туманом' is the instrumental after 'покрылся' to show what covered the forest. 'Белым' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Dative with preposition. 'Туману' takes the dative after 'навстречу' to mean moving toward. 'Корабли' is the nominative plural subject of 'плывут'.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Туманы' is the nominative plural subject of 'бывают', taking the regular -ы ending. 'На реке' gives the location, and 'часто' adds frequency.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Туманов' is the genitive plural after 'много', taking the -ов ending for masculine nouns. 'Осенью' sets the season.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Тумане' is the prepositional after 'о' to express the topic. 'Вчерашнем' agrees in the masculine prepositional, and 'говорили' introduces discussion.
Strategic focus: Nominative description. 'Туман' is nominative as the subject. 'Холодный' is the agreeing masculine adjective, reinforced by 'очень'. A clean descriptive model.
